text_block_list.text:
Hoping to take a breather,
I invited Light Hello out.
When I arrived at the meeting spot……

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
――All right, let's have the audio equipment brought in tomorrow.
Thank you very much.
(*Grumbleee……*)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Come to think of it, I haven't eaten lunch.
Work's been so hectic today.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
! Trainer-san!
Wah... I-I'm so sorry, I didn't notice you!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine, really!
I forget to eat all the time, so――
(*Grummmbbllle……*)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hau!
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself too hard isn't good, you know.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Urk... You're right.
If I collapsed during our special outing,
it'd defeat the whole purpose.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Um, there's a shop I used to frequent nearby.
If you'd like, we could go there...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ah... nostalgic... It hasn't changed at all since my school days.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Wait, ah! The weekly limited-edition dessert!
They still have it now!
choice_data_list: Is that a familiar favorite on the menu?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yes! I used to eat this a lot with my friends♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Calling it "pre-workout nutrient replenishment,"
she took her sweet time savoring every bite...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Before we knew it, training time had arrived.
I remember all of us getting chewed out by our trainers.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Still, the moment she caught wind of next week's new sweets,
she'd cheerfully say, 'Let's go again!'... Fufu♪
choice_data_list: So it's that trendy sweet everyone's talking about.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You bet they were!
Ev-er-y-one was totally hooked!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Word of mouth spreads information way faster
than the academy's flyers ever could――

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ――Ha!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: That's it, word of mouth! That's another great angle!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
For girls that age, it's the ultimate source of information.
If we use it to announce the event, too...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh♪ Taking a breather really is a lifesaver!
From now on, I need to treasure my time outside of work too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Right, gotta take a note!
Write it down before I forget...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Ah! ...A-Ahaha~.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I've gone and done it again.
I dread to think what lies ahead...

She always ends up prioritizing her work.
At this rate, she's going to push herself too hard again.
In that case……
choice_data_list: Let's take a break together again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Huh! That would be immensely appreciated, but...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I was just worried that I might make you feel
unnecessarily obligated, Trainer...
choice_data_list: I've been wondering how to take a breather, too.
I've been wondering how to unwind, too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I see.
You're very busy too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
If it won't be too much trouble for you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
By all means!
Let's refresh ourselves together!

And so, I ended up going out with
Light Hello from time to time to unwind.
